description: This is a test class for the BearerTokenValidator in the OAuth server module of the OrangeHRM system. It contains multiple test methods to validate various scenarios such as missing authorization header, invalid token formats, expired tokens, revoked tokens, and non-existent tokens. The class sets up mock data and dependencies to verify the behavior of the BearerTokenValidator under different conditions.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidatorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the BearerTokenValidator, testing various scenarios of bearer token validation such as missing headers, invalid tokens, expired tokens, revoked tokens, and non-existing tokens.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, loads test data from a YAML file, and sets up the access token repository and encryption key for use in tests.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithoutAuthorizeHeader
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the authorization header is missing in the request. Expects an OAuthServerException with a specific message and hint.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the authorization header has an invalid value that cannot be decrypted properly, expecting a LogicException.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidToken
methods.description: Tests the case of an invalid token string in the authorization header, expecting a LogicException due to invalid hex encoding.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidEncryptionKey
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the token cannot be verified due to an incorrect encryption key, expecting an OAuthServerException indicating integrity check failure.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithRevokedToken
methods.description: Simulates a revoked token and expects an OAuthServerException indicating the token has been revoked.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithNonExistingToken
methods.description: Tests the case where the token's ID does not exist in the database after decryption, expecting a verification failure.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredToken
methods.description: Simulates an expired token based on current date, expecting an OAuthServerException indicating token expiration.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredTokenAfterOneYear
methods.description: Checks behavior when token is expired with a current date one year after expiry, expecting expiration error.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredAndCurrentTimeSame
methods.description: Validates token expiration when current time matches the expiry time, and asserts that the access token attributes are correctly parsed.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorization
methods.description: Tests successful validation of a valid token, confirming the access token object attributes.
